title: Working Paper of the Equity Accounting Desk: The Allocation a Restated Membership and Patronage Equity Notice Carries
content:
A notice under Membership and Patronage Equity is restated on the volume the notice was posted on, taken from the allocation line the notice carries for each basis. For the refined fuels basis the volume is the volume standing accrued for the year on that basis.

The rate for each basis is the rate the notice for the year restated carries for that basis.

The restated allocation is worked out basis by basis: the volume for each basis is multiplied by the rate that basis carries, each product is rounded to two decimal places, and the three products are added. No holdback is taken, and the sum so reached is rounded to two decimal places and stands as the restated allocation. Amounts worked out under this rule are carried to two decimal places, a half cent rounding up.

## The same rule set out as a working paper

| Line | Quantity | Where it comes from |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | grain volume | the volume the notice was posted on for the grain basis |
| 2 | grain rate | the rate the notice carries for the grain basis |
| 3 | grain product | line 1 multiplied by line 2, rounded to two decimal places |
| 4 | crop input volume | the volume the notice was posted on for the crop input basis |
| 5 | crop input rate | the rate the notice carries for the crop input basis |
| 6 | crop input product | line 4 multiplied by line 5, rounded to two decimal places |
| 7 | refined fuels volume | the volume standing accrued for the year on the refined fuels basis |
| 8 | refined fuels rate | the rate the notice carries for the refined fuels basis |
| 9 | refined fuels product | line 7 multiplied by line 8, rounded to two decimal places |
| 10 | restated allocation | lines 3, 6 and 9 added, the sum rounded to two decimal places |

Each of the three products is rounded before they are added, and the sum is rounded again. The rounding is not left to the end alone.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A notice posted on 31450.00 bushels at 0.045 a bushel gives 1415.25. The same notice posted on 18200.00 of crop input spend at 0.018 in the dollar gives 327.60. The year stands accrued at 4100.00 gallons on the refined fuels basis, and the notice carries 0.025 a gallon for it, giving 102.50. Added, the three products come to 1845.35, and that figure, rounded to two decimal places, is the restated allocation.
